newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Duratex still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Duratex still a buy.

text.p: Fator Securities said Monday it reaffirmed its buy recommendation on Brazilian construction materials firm Duratex after the company reported first-half 1997 results that were in line with forecasts.
-- Fator analyst Terezinha Moniz said in a report that a recovery in real estate financing was boosting the civil construction and construction materials sectors.
-- "The company's fundamentals are solid and its potential upside of 68.2 percent until the end of the year is another reason for our buy recommendation," she wrote.
-- The opening of new plants, including Deca in Argentina and MDF in Brazil are expecdted to improve Duratex's results in the second half.
-- She added that the outlook for results and low multiples "reinforce our buy recommendation for Duratex."
-- Duratex common was unchanged at its Friday's close of 43 reais while its preferred was off 1.67 percent at 59 reais at 1455 local/1355 gmt in Sao Paulo.
